text: Land is plowed twice, roughly two to three weeks apart, with the field left to dry and weather in the sun for 10-15 days between plowings to break down clods and reduce soil-borne pests. Beds/mounds are raised for drainage, with row spacing and plant spacing set out before planting so that irrigation lines and trellis posts can be positioned consistently.
caveat: Precise bed width and plant/row spacing numbers were partially illegible in the source scan; only the general two-plow, dry-fallow land prep sequence is confirmed with confidence.
